author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Private publishing and sharing clearley emerged as a theme at the #IndieWeb Summit. I attended a remote session on AutoAuth in Amål and we had two concurrent sessions on private groups and private webmentions.

I attended the session proposed by Jonathan LeClour as he is also a Known user.

Known already has great privacy options. I can publish publicly, to members only, or privatley. Our idea is to leverage this feature so you can subscribe to someone and they become a user on your site.

You can find more about the path we are taking by following this issue.

We need to solve the ability for private sharing and folks are getting close with AutoAuth, but we maybe able to do a lot using the multiuser set up of Known.

Excited about the future...you can't read it....the post was shared privately.
